newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil gains on futures, diesel strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil gains on futures, diesel strong.

text.p: NWE gas oil was stronger on Thursday, boosted by higher futures and firming of certain grades' premiums.
May IPE last traded $1.75 a tonne higher at $164.75 in thin volume and predominantly position squaring.
Diesel retained its leading role with premiums gaining on the back of tight supplies.
"We are not seeing much Russian coming into the market," said one trader.
A washout deal was done at May IPE +$13.50 and offers were heard as high as May IPE +$14 cif NWE.
A bid for Thames basis material at May +$11 was also heard.
Heating oil saw a Russian 11,000 0.2 pct cargo trading into Bremen at May IPE +$4 and a small part cargo, 5,000 tonnes, being sold ex-Ventspils at mean of mean -$4.50.
FOD was little talked, but DIN was attacting a bid of May IPE +$5 for 1-10 dates into Hamburg.
Heating oil barges were very lacklustre with talk for Rotterdam refinery material at May IPE +$1 and 50 cents less for stored product.
